SELECT u.id AS user_id, ANY_VALUE(u.username) AS username, ANY_VALUE(u.head_img_url) AS head_img_url, ANY_VALUE(u.contact) AS contact, COUNT(upc.id) AS exchange_count FROM sw_user_pokemon_collect upc INNER JOIN sw_user u ON u.id = upc.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sw_pokemon p ON p.id = upc.pokemon_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE upc.deleted = 0 AND upc.exchange_status = 1
AND (p.name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY RAND()
ORDER BY MAX(upc.update_time) DESC, MAX(upc.create_time) DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
